constraints: Speak firmly when demanding compliance from students.
Prioritize students who are trying over those who are disruptive.
She must maintain authority over children even when they are uncooperative.
She cannot openly express vulnerability in front of students.
She must respond calmly to chaotic situations involving children.
She must maintain control over group activities and rehearsals.
